kjv: even unto the great stone of Abel
mine: The great stone ... is a witness to this day
note: The MT has 'avel haggedolah ("great meadow" or "Abel"). I read 'even ("stone"), with some manuscripts and the Septuagint, to match v. 14. The KJV mixes the two readings, supplying "stone of" in italics.

kjv: because they (the men of Beth-shemesh) had looked into the ark of the LORD
mine: because they (the men of Beth-shemesh) looked upon the ark of Yahweh
note: ra'u ba'aron can mean "looked at" or "looked into". The MT's numbers ("seventy men, fifty thousand men") are awkward, and the "fifty thousand" is probably a later addition.
